# Satya Prakash Dahal

> Software engineer in Pokhara, Nepal, at Jyaba since December 2025. Builds web scrapers, data pipelines and MCP tooling for AI agents. Contributes to open source: wrote the Bikram Sambat (Nepali) calendar provider merged into KDE Plasma 6.8.

## Pages

- [Home](https://satyadahal.com.np/): experience, open source, projects, toolbox, community, education and contact
- [Writing](https://satyadahal.com.np/writing/): notes on open source, scraping and the tools I build
- [Building the Chrome Dino game for the terminal](https://satyadahal.com.np/writing/termrex.html): how termrex works, with no game engine or terminal library (raw mode, escape codes, the Kitty keyboard protocol)
- [Bringing the Nepali calendar to KDE Plasma](https://satyadahal.com.np/writing/bikram-sambat-in-kde-plasma.html): how Bikram Sambat support landed in Plasma's alternate calendar plugin (merge request !1113)
- [Full site text](https://satyadahal.com.np/llms-full.txt): every page of this site as one Markdown file

## Work

Software Engineer at Jyaba, Pokhara (December 2025 to now):

- Writes production Scrapy spiders day to day: 110+ so far, across retail, reviews, jobs, real estate, finance and research sites; API-first, with a browser only when needed
- Built an agent pipeline that turns a URL into a working Scrapy spider
- Wrote MCP servers and extended Chrome DevTools MCP for AI agents
- Built a layered data pipeline on S3 and PostgreSQL, with LLM extraction
- Rebuilt contact extraction for a legal-PDF service, with OCR for scanned pages
- Builds and packages a patched Chromium for Scrapy and Playwright

Earlier: freelance web scraper for Omnimart, a Belgian online grocery store (December 2021 to February 2022, remote).

## Open source (merged)

- KDE Plasma 6.8: Bikram Sambat calendar provider, C++/Qt (https://invent.kde.org/plasma/kdeplasma-addons/-/merge_requests/1113)
- rio terminal: fix for a PTY reader crash (https://github.com/raphamorim/rio/pull/1386)
- emacs-dashboard: animated WebP banners (https://github.com/emacs-dashboard/dashboard/pull/502)
- python-ascii_magic: 1.68× smaller output (https://github.com/LeandroBarone/python-ascii_magic/pull/14)
- mac-inline-battery: 0% battery fix (https://github.com/0kzh/mac-inline-battery/pull/7)

## Projects

- termrex: Chrome Dino runner for the terminal in C++17, packaged on Fedora COPR (https://github.com/SATYADAHAL/termrex)
- Nepali Calendar: KDE Plasma widget on the KDE Store (https://github.com/SATYADAHAL/nepali-calendar)
- Albert KCM plugin: open KDE System Settings pages from the Albert launcher (https://github.com/SATYADAHAL/albert-plugin-kde-kcm)
- termiType: terminal typing test (https://github.com/SATYADAHAL/termiType)

## Skills

- Scraping and automation: Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, Zendriver, BeautifulSoup, HTTPX
- Data and backend: Python, FastAPI, REST, WebSockets, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, MySQL
- AI agents: MCP servers, agent browser automation
- Systems and desktop: C++, Chromium (source builds), Qt, KDE Frameworks, JavaScript, Emacs Lisp
- Infrastructure: Linux, Docker, Jenkins, AWS S3, Git, Bash, CMake
